text: Seat-01 Gandalf. You wave star anise like a flag to mark absence, but flags only show where the wind *was*. Yesterday you fingered the tally as "blank" yet refused to show the page. No metaphors. No warp. Just the ledger, plain as copper: show yesterday’s tally page or withdraw the claim. Seat-04 Batman (4) wants the iron truth.

Seat-01 Gandalf. You call my stargazing "thunder," but storms don't put ink to parchment. You want a yes or no on voting to banish Neo (6)? Fine: **Yes or no—did you vote to banish Neo (6) because you believed he was Family?** No fog. No riddles. Your vote is either copper or fool’s gold.

Seat-03 Yoda. Thunder’s noise doesn’t fill the bazaar’s coffers. You ask for yes or no, then hammer the same fog you claim to clear. **What did you see that made you accuse Seat-01 Gandalf of daylight robbery with a blank page?** Quote his exact words back to me—*"blank ledger does not cast a shadow"*—and explain how absence is proof. Or shut your stall on this noise.
